title: The Ozone Hole Is Healing. Here's Why
description:
CFCs from fridges and sprays damaged the ozone layer. The 1987 Montreal Protocol phased them out. UNEP/WMO expect recovery by about 2040 for most of the world and around 2066 over Antarctica.
